_comment: Reviewed list of corpus artefacts that are KNOWN not to migrate. scripts/check_corpus_gate.py treats it as an exact match in both directions: an artefact that fails and is not listed fails the gate, and a listed artefact that now migrates, fails differently or reports other blockers fails the gate too, so this file can only shrink towards empty. Keys are '<batch>/<artefact path inside the batch>'. 'category' is the batch state's error category, every 'details' fragment must occur in its error details (keep them free of absolute paths), 'blockers' is the exact set of quality-report blockers, and 'reason' says why the limitation is accepted. Do not add an entry to silence a regression.

details: Hyper source lacks an exact physical identity; full-data import cannot be bound safely.
blockers: Migration failed during generation: Hyper source lacks an exact physical identity; full-data import cannot be bound safely.
real_world/Cache.twbx.reason: The workbook packages only a legacy .tde extract (Data/en_US-US/Sales Target.tde). The Hyper API refuses it ('invalid magic value in header'), so no complete CSV/Parquet export can be produced, and sampling or falling back to the historical live source is not acceptable. Re-saving the extract as .hyper in Tableau Desktop would make it migratable.
